name: Svalbard & Jan Mayen
prevalence_note: Sysselmesteren is the Norwegian government authority on Svalbard. Økokrim and Politiet have warned nationally that callers spoof police or Økokrim numbers, press people for BankID, and run fake crypto-investment platforms; those warnings apply wherever Norwegian criminal law and BankID are in daily use, including Longyearbyen. No Svalbard-only case count was published. Jan Mayen has no ordinary civilian town.
cross_border_note: Svalbard and Jan Mayen use Norway's +47 numbering. A caller ID that resembles an Økokrim or Nord-Norge police extension can be spoofed from abroad, which is the exact method Økokrim described when its staff numbers were misused.

scams.name: Falsk Økokrim- eller politibetjent som krever BankID
scams.name_en: Økokrim and Politiet warning: spoofed police or Økokrim calls demanding BankID, passwords or an urgent transfer

red_flag_keywords.text: flytt pengene til en sikker konto

scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be from Økokrim, a police district or a bank, often with an apparently official display, and asks the person in Svalbard to share BankID, a password or other sensitive details, or to move money at once. Økokrim has said its own staff numbers have been misused in this way.
scams.legit_en: Politiet, Økokrim and the banks do not ask anyone, including residents of Longyearbyen, to read out a BankID code or to move funds to a 'safe account' during an unexpected call. A real check is started by the person hanging up and using the agency's official channel, or by contacting Sysselmesteren.
bait_tactics: Avslutt samtalen og slå opp Sysselmesteren eller banken på offisiell nettside, ikke på nummeret som vises i displayet.
Si at BankID aldri oppgis på uanmeldt telefon, uansett hvem som ringer.
Spør hvilket politidistrikt eller hvilken avdeling i Økokrim vedkommende påstår å representere, og tilby å ta saken via offisiell inngang i Longyearbyen.

scams.name: Fiktiv krypto-investeringsplattform
scams.name_en: Økokrim-reported investment fraud on fictitious crypto platforms
context_keywords: gebyr for å ta ut gevinst

red_flag_keywords.text: betal gebyr for å frigjøre gevinst
overfør mer for å låse opp kontoen

scams.signals_en: Økokrim has repeatedly received reports of people being drawn into fictitious investment platforms that claim to trade crypto-assets, display invented profits, and then demand extra payments before any withdrawal.
scams.legit_en: A lawful investment firm serving a person in Svalbard must be a properly supervised Norwegian or EEA provider. It charges no urgent 'unlock' fee, and it does not insist that the client stay on a private chat instead of using the firm's official login.
bait_tactics: Be om organisasjonsnummer og si at det skal sjekkes i offisielle norske registre, ikke på plattformen som ringer.
Avvis krav om gebyr for å ta ut penger som angivelig allerede står på konto.
Tilby å ta med tilbudet til banken i Longyearbyen før det overføres noe som helst.
